summary: iteration_5: Verified the PDF cover-page clipping fix in handleDownloadPDF (App.js). Triggered full PDF export from the live app via data-testid=pdf-download-button, waited ~6 min for 149 pages (~135 MB), converted the resulting PDF back to images and visually inspected cover, p2, p5, p15, p38 (image page), p50, p75, p100 (chapter divider). Cover page now contains BOTH previously-missing pieces: the 'PREPARED FOR / ISSUE DATE / CLASSIFICATION' row with values 'Alamaan Exchange / September 2026 / Confidential', AND the bottom line 'SULTANATE OF OMAN · MUSCAT · ENGLISH EDITION'. No JS/console errors during export. No regressions detected on sampled pages (chapter divider p100 still clean, image page p38 renders correctly, text pages sharp).

issues: Very minor: bottom row values (Alamaan Exchange / September 2026 / Confidential) sit close to the horizontal separator and may look ~1-2px tight because the natural cover height slightly exceeds A4 causing an imperceptible fit-scale; all text remains fully readable and no content is lost. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: handleDownloadPDF (App.js ~L92-141) fit logic is correct: capture at natural height + fit-into-A4 with aspect preservation. Sound approach.

PDF is ~135 MB for 149 pages; scale=3 + JPEG 0.97 + compression NONE is very heavy. Consider scale=2 and pdf compress:true / addImage compression 'FAST' for smaller files with negligible visual loss (optional optimization, not a regression).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF export button data-testid=pdf-download-button. Export takes ~5-6 min; use expect_download with timeout>=420s. Use pdftoppm to render pages of the resulting PDF for visual inspection. Cover page clipping bug from iteration_4 is fixed as of iteration_5.
rca of the issue: In iteration_4 each .a4 was locked to height:297mm + overflow:hidden during html2canvas, clipping any content overflowing 297mm on the cover (bottom row + Sultanate line). Fix in iteration_5: during capture, set height:auto/overflow:visible so the entire natural page is rendered, then compute drawW/drawH to fit the whole captured image inside the A4 bounds preserving aspect ratio (offsetX centers horizontally if scaled down). Verified via extracted cover-001.jpg that both previously-missing rows are now present.
